name: Dev-loop test suite (fixtures + Playwright e2e)
description:
Fixture corpus of real, recorded shop pages — per template number, per page type, including edge cases (missing marker, duplicated marker, marker inside a comment/script, minified HTML, <base> tag, exotic encodings). Assert: bundle injected exactly once, at the right marker, every other byte unchanged.

Recorded HTTP fixtures including headers: gzip/br/zstd bodies, Set-Cookie with Secure/Domain, redirects with absolute Location, CSP headers, Upgrade-Insecure-Requests, Content-Type variants that must not be intercepted.

Dedicated fixtures for the rendered-version bug class: cookie loss across redirects, stale version ids, forced refresh — dev must detect and report, never silently show the wrong thing.

Playwright end-to-end test against a locally served fixture shop: start dev, load the page, assert the injected script actually executed (a sentinel on window), edit a source file, assert hot-swap without full reload.

Reference: cli-greenfield.md §12.
